subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway/OpenResponses binary `input_file` receipt contract for Excel and allowlisted binaries, or narrow this issue to Excel while routing generic/provider-native file behavior to related trackers?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining work defines public upload, storage, redaction, and tool-access semantics that need product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, retention, and tool-access rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Excel Receipts
options.body: Limit this issue to allowlisted Excel persistence and route generic binary and provider-native forwarding to the broader file-input issues.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Or API Design
options.body: Leave core behavior unchanged until a plugin or ClawHub package proves the workflow and any missing extension APIs are clear.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, retention, and tool-access rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the input-file, media-understanding, and document-extraction seams that the decision would extend.
